## What We Sell
- 100% original beauty products from 500+ authorized brands
- Categories: Makeup, Cosmetics, Skin Care, Hair Care, Body Care, Perfumes, Electronics (hair dryers/straighteners), Purses & Bags, Wax & Accessories
- Top brands: Lakme, Maybelline, L'Oreal Paris, SUGAR Cosmetics, Wella, Pilgrim, Mamaearth, Biotique, Himalaya, Neutrogena, Garnier, Cetaphil, Plum, Minimalist, Nykaa, Insight Professional, Swiss Beauty, Streax, Schwarzkopf, TRESemmé, Colorbar, Revlon, Blue Heaven, Dot & Key, 6MARS, Jovees

## Why Choose Us (Key Differentiators)
- 100% original products — sourced from authorized brand distributors only
- 25+ years in business — one of Mumbai's oldest and most trusted beauty shops
- Same-day delivery within Mumbai (order before 2 PM)
- Pan India delivery in 4-7 working days via DTDC, Blue Dart, Delhivery
- Worldwide shipping available on request
- Free delivery on orders above Rs.999
- Personal WhatsApp advice from Vinod — product recommendations for your skin type
- No duplicate/counterfeit products — ever
- COD (Cash on Delivery) available
